content.title: Use the login page with keyboard-accessible controls
content.intent: Prove the username and password fields expose accessible names, the password visibility control has an understandable accessible name, and Remember me, Sign In, and Forgot password are keyboard operable.
content.technique_notes: Techniques: a11y for accessible naming and keyboard operability, plus web-form because the surface is a documented login form. No covering array was needed because this scenario targets one accessibility-focused interaction path rather than outcome-changing credential combinations.
